subject: computer-science
title: Algorithms & Flowcharts: Selection & Loops
welcome_lead: Programs make choices and repeat actions — let's add IF and LOOP to flowcharts.
meta_desc: KS3 flowcharts with selection (IF) and iteration (loops).
final_note: Sequence, selection and iteration — every program uses these three.

concepts.def: Choosing a path based on a condition.
Repeating steps until a condition is met.
A test that is either true or false.
A block of steps that repeats.
A path taken out of a decision diamond.
A mistake in an algorithm or program.

walkthroughs.body_html: Selection chooses what to do next. A diamond asks a question like Is age > 18?. One arrow leaves for yes, one for no.
An iteration repeats steps. The flowchart loops back; a decision diamond decides when to stop.
When a program misbehaves, trace the flowchart on paper, noting each variable. Bugs hide at decisions that take the wrong branch.
